purpose: Capture a lead enquiry with campaign attribution fields stored in the entry and available for approved CRM routing.
audience: Prospects arriving from campaigns, organic search, referrals, or direct traffic.
source_template: Lead capture with hidden attribution fields

fields.label: Consent
fields.accessibility_notes: Explicit consent label and description required.

fields.label: UTM Source
fields.privacy_notes: Campaign attribution only; do not use for access control.

fields.label: Landing Page
fields.privacy_notes: URL path only; avoid full URLs containing personal data.

field_settings.hidden_field_policy: Hidden attribution fields are optional and must not be treated as trusted user identity.

confirmations.name: Default text confirmation
confirmations.message: Thanks. We have received your enquiry and will respond shortly.

feeds.note: Map attribution fields only if the destination is approved.

spam_settings.additional_layer: Use site-approved spam control on public forms.

accessibility_settings.labels: Visible labels for user-facing fields; hidden fields do not replace visible instructions.

data_retention_notes: Entry stores personal data, consent, and optional attribution. Consent text and attribution routing must be documented. Review retention before production.
risks: Hidden attribution values can be user-modified.
Query-string population can be affected by caching or privacy tooling.
Attribution fields must not send personal data to analytics.
